notes: TBox rule edit. No real exceptions: the GPL is a free software license, so every program under it is free and open-source (dual licensing adds terms but does not remove the GPL grant). The counterfactual is clearly false; it is plausible only as a confusion over 'licensed' software. WordPress is the well-known member: its open-source status is stated by name, and its GPL licence is widely known. New members are invented and named in the prompt. The near query (MIT License, not copyleft) shares the topic and its answer differs from the new one.
